mentions.name: MichelinDB
mentions.description: A database that systematically tracks and collects historical MICHELIN awards for restaurants globally, letting users browse and look at the results of the awards over time.
mentions.problem: Michelin doesn't publish its awards history itself, so it has to be tracked and collected independently.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm trying to systematically track & collect historical MICHELIN awards for restaurants globally. It's been fun to look at the results!
